newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran commissions Bandar Khomeini petchem unit.
newsitem.headline: Iran commissions Bandar Khomeini petchem unit.

text.p: Iran has commissioned a one million tonnes a year capacity aromatic unit at its Bandar Khomeini petrochemical plant, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Monday.
The unit was commissioned in the presence of the country's President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, IRNA reported.
Bandar Khomeini produces 2.3 million tonnes a year of liquefied gas and this will be increased to 3.3 million tonnes, Abbas Moqaddam, the complex's managing director told IRNA.
The plant has been producing liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) since 1990.
It exported 677,000 tonnes of chemical products -- mainly "liquid gas" -- worth some $130 million in the first six months of the current Iranian year which started on March 20.
Plant capacity is an annual 5.5 million tonnes.
Iran is the Middle East's second largest petrochemical producer behind Saudi Arabia.
